summary: Full backend + frontend test of the Nirman Udyog rebrand (Navy/Ivory/Gold/Stone palette, Cormorant Garamond + Manrope fonts) and the brand-new Catalogue Library feature. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 4 new tests covering catalogue-categories endpoint, public list, PDF upload + full admin CRUD (create/publish/track-download/unpublish/delete + invalid category rejection + non-PDF rejection), and a gallery photo count regression check. All 31 pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend end-to-end: logged in as admin, created a real catalogue via /admin/catalogues/new UI (title input via data-testid=catalogue-form-title, PVT category select, PDF uploaded via [data-testid=pdf-uploader-trigger] file chooser, showed filename chip on success), Save Catalogue button worked and redirected back to admin list showing 'PVT · TEST_FE_Catalogue · 0 downloads'. Public /catalogues page then rendered the new catalogue card with gold PVT badge, generic PDF icon placeholder (no cover), navy 'View' + 'Download' buttons — verified 'TEST_FE_Catalogue' present in DOM. Homepage [data-testid=catalogue-preview-section] appeared with count=1 as soon as a published catalogue existed (was 0 when DB empty — correct conditional render). Test catalogue cleaned up via API after verification. REGRESSION: verified navbar transparent-over-hero at top of Home (bg rgba(0,0,0,0)) and hero shows Cormorant serif H1 'Tiles that finish the room...', gold eyebrow, Explore Collections + View Catalogues CTAs, and PREMIUM SURFACES metadata bar. All secondary pages (/gallery, /tiles/bathroom, /tiles/bedroom, /about, /contact, /blog, /404) render with Cormorant Garamond headings + Manrope body font, navy/ivory/gold palette applied consistently, zero page-level React errors. Gallery still shows 78 elements (>=76 real demo photos) — untouched. TileDetail /tile/{slug} loads cleanly with ZERO 'Maximum update depth exceeded' warnings — the iteration_3 critical bug from StickyBarContext appears to have been fixed. WhatsApp sticky button + Enquire card render correctly with new palette. 5-column footer with new Resources column (Catalogues/Gallery/Journal) renders correctly on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: catalogue_router.py: slug is derived from title+category — two catalogues with the same title+category would produce duplicate slugs and a 500 on insert (no unique index handling). Consider appending id/timestamp or catching duplicate-key gracefully.

catalogue_router.py POST /api/catalogues/{slug}/track-download is an unauthenticated public endpoint with no rate-limiting or existence check — a script could spam it to inflate download_count. Acceptable for MVP but worth a note.

upload_router.py PDF content-type check falls back to filename extension check, but does not sniff the magic bytes — a renamed .pdf malicious file could be stored. Low risk since object storage doesn't execute content, but a %PDF- header check would harden this.
CatalogueForm.jsx: title <input> lacks explicit type='text' (defaults to text so functionally OK); has data-testid so no action needed.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created one TEST_FE_Catalogue (PVT, featured, published, small fake PDF) via admin UI to verify end-to-end display, then cleaned up via API. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full rebrand + Catalogue Library shipped cleanly. Backend suite is at 31 tests, all green. Iteration_3's TileDetail infinite render loop is resolved (0 Maximum-update warnings on /tile/{slug}). Only nits are the code-review points on catalogue slug uniqueness and unauth track-download endpoint — not blocking. When re-testing, remember: admin catalogue delete button is inside the row; if not visible, use API cleanup (POST login then DELETE /api/admin/catalogues/{id}). Public catalogues page renders PVT/GVT/Ceramic/Gres category badges in gold, View button outlined, Download button filled navy — matches spec. Homepage CataloguePreview only mounts if there's >=1 published catalogue.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
